title: Implement typed Linux probe and stop control
objective: Add additive server CLI commands that classify lock ownership and deliver ownership-checked SIGTERM.
output_format: Go production code plus T0/T2 tests, FakeVsReal fidelity backstop, and invariant contract test.
tool_guidance: Extend the existing server subcommand and daemon-lock seams without changing existing daemon mode behavior.
task_boundaries: Own typed supervisor-probe and supervisor-stop Linux controls; exclude Windows lifecycle and SCM implementation.
acceptance: Probe distinguishes absent, matched running, mismatch, and unknown.
Stop rejects stale or mismatched ownership and reaches SIGTERM.
decision_closure_reason: Probe classification, ownership token revalidation, and SIGTERM behavior are fixed by the adoption authority ADR and implementation member.
